text: [[i]]A young officer of Changshan asks leave to follow you instead. Gongsun Zan does not stop him.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Gongsun Zan has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it. [[b]]Zhao Yun[[/b]] await your word.\\n\\nTaking them into your household will cost you in silver and in the goodwill of those you leave behind. Refusing costs you nothing but the men.

[[i]]Word of your conduct reaches men who knew you before any of this began.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Gongsun Zan has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it. [[i]]The great houses of Xu decide, quietly, that you are the safer bet.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Tao Qian has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it. Refusing costs you nothing but the men.

[[i]]Mi Zhu gives you his sister, his brother and his fortune. [[i]]Three times you climb the hill at Longzhong. The third time, he is awake.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Liu Biao has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it. [[i]]He asked you, on his deathbed, to take it. [[i]]They want a soldier to deal with Zhang Lu. [[i]]The pretence ends. The men who arranged it march with you.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Liu Yan has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it. [[i]]Wu Yi offers you his sister, and with her the gentry of Yi. Administrators, not soldiers -- and it is administrators who hold a province.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Liu Yan has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it. [[i]]The city opens rather than burn. Yi passes to you, and with it the young men who will still be serving your house long after you are gone.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Liu Yan has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it. Refusing costs you nothing but the men.

[[i]]The cousins come first. They always do.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Ma Teng has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it. [[i]]His family is dead in Ye and he has nowhere left. He kneels at Chengdu.[[/i]]\\n\\nYour standing with Ma Teng has reached the point where men in their service will follow you instead, and they will not stand in the way of it.
